code: (()=>{const {stage,root,emitters}=window.__arenaProbe;const V3=Object.getPrototypeOf(stage.camera.position).constructor;const pools=[];root.traverse(o=>{if(o.isMesh&&o.material&&o.material.blending===2&&o.geometry.type==='CircleGeometry'&&o.visible){const p=new V3();o.getWorldPosition(p);pools.push({x:+p.x.toFixed(2),z:+p.z.toFixed(2),r:+(o.scale.x).toFixed(2)});}});const out=pools.map(p=>{let best=1e9,kind='NONE';for(const e of emitters){const d=Math.hypot(p.x-e.x,p.z-e.z);if(d<best){best=d;kind=e.kind;}}const v=new V3(p.x,0.02,p.z).project(stage.camera);return {r:p.r,src:kind,dist:+best.toFixed(2),sx:Math.round((v.x*0.5+0.5)*window.innerWidth),sy:Math.round((-v.y*0.5+0.5)*window.innerHeight)};});const worst=out.reduce((a,b)=>b.dist>a.dist?b:a,out[0]);console.log('[POOLS]',JSON.stringify({n:out.length,worstDist:worst.dist,onScreen:out.filter(p=>p.sx>0&&p.sx<1600&&p.sy>0&&p.sy<900),kinds:emitters.reduce((m,e)=>{m[e.kind]=(m[e.kind]||0)+1;return m;},{})}));return out.length})()
